connector.name: LatLng
connector.registryDescription: Geocoding, reverse geocoding, and places search for LatLng.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.latlng.work over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace work.latlng.mcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using a LatLng dashboard Server Key. Must start with latlng_. Create one at https://dash.latlng.work.
